a.clean: Section 3 of the design doc describes the evaluation pipeline. The pipeline reads checkpoints from the shared bucket, runs the benchmark suite on each one, and writes the scores to a results table. We run it nightly at 3 a.m. Each run takes about 40 minutes on four GPUs. If a checkpoint fails to load, the pipeline logs the error and skips it rather than stopping. The dashboard shows the latest scores along with the delta from the previous night. One open question is whether we should also track memory usage. I think yes, but it needs a separate collector. We'll revisit this after the first quarter.
